description: Law enforcement staffing reported to FBI CDE for the nation, a state, or an agency, one row per year from 1985 through the current year: male and female sworn officers, male and female civilian employees, law enforcement employees per 1,000 people, the participated population, and the percent of population coverage (state and national scope only). The per-1,000 rate is CDE's published figure, passed through as sent; it can differ slightly from the four counts over the participated population. CDE sends no totals; add the four counts for all employees. National scope omits identifiers; state requires only state_abbr; agency requires only ori (look it up with fbi_search_agencies). A year CDE has not published, including the current year until it does, returns a row of nulls; when no requested year has any value, as for an unrecognized state or ORI, the call fails with no_data.

from_year.description: First year (inclusive), 1985 through the current year.

ori.description: Nine ASCII-letter/digit ORI code (e.g. CA0010400, DCMPD0000); case-insensitive. Find an agency's ORI with fbi_search_agencies. Only permitted and required for agency scope.

scope.description: Geographic scope: national (omit identifiers), state (only state_abbr), or agency (only ori).

state_abbr.description: Two ASCII-letter state abbreviation (e.g. CA, DC, PR); case-insensitive. Only permitted and required for state scope.

to_year.description: Last year (inclusive), 1985 through the current year.

name: fbi_get_police_employees

data_last_updated.description: Date CDE last refreshed UCR data; absent when CDE omits it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `scope_param_missing`: scope is "state" but state_abbr is missing, or scope is "agency" but ori is missing. `scope_param_incompatible`: Identifiers are supplied for a scope that does not apply them. `year_out_of_range`: from_year or to_year is after the current UTC year. `invalid_date_range`: from_year is later than to_year. `no_data`: CDE returned no value for any requested year: an unrecognized state or ORI, or years with no published employee counts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

max_data_date.description: CDE's latest UCR data month (MM/YYYY), not the latest staffing year; absent when CDE omits it.

ori.description: Uppercased ORI code; present only for agency scope.

state_abbr.description: Uppercased state abbreviation; present only for state scope.

years.description: One row per year CDE returned, ascending. A year CDE has not published keeps its row with every value null.

items.description: Staffing values CDE published for one year.

employees_per_1000.description: Law enforcement employees per 1,000 people as CDE publishes it, never recomputed; it can differ slightly from the four counts over participated_population. Null when CDE sent no value.

female_civilians.description: Female civilian employees (CDE "Female Civilians"); null when CDE sent no value.

female_officers.description: Female sworn officers (CDE "Female Officers"); null when CDE sent no value.

male_civilians.description: Male civilian employees (CDE "Male Civilians"); null when CDE sent no value.

male_officers.description: Male sworn officers (CDE "Male Officers"); null when CDE sent no value.

participated_population.description: Population of the reporting agencies (CDE "Participated Population"); null when CDE sent no value.

population_coverage_percent.description: Percent of population coverage as CDE supplies it for state and national scope; always null at agency scope, where CDE sends none.

title: FBI Get Police Employees
